TariffConfig.title: TariffConfig
TariffConfig.description: Spanish 2.0TD electricity tariff pricing configuration (fixed 24h or 3-period).

name.description: Optional company or tariff display name

powerP1Price.description: Contracted power P1 price in EUR/kW/day

powerP2Price.description: Contracted power P2 price in EUR/kW/day

samePowerPrice.description: Whether P1 and P2 share the same daily power rate

ConsumptionSplit.title: ConsumptionSplit
ConsumptionSplit.description: Percentage split of monthly electricity usage across 2.0TD periods.

ConsumptionProfile.title: ConsumptionProfile
ConsumptionProfile.description: Household monthly consumption, contracted power, period split, and tax preference.

monthlyKwh.description: Estimated monthly energy usage in kWh

powerP1Kw.description: Contracted P1 peak power in kW

powerP2Kw.description: Contracted P2 off-peak power in kW

samePowerKw.description: Whether P1 and P2 have identical contracted power

includeTaxes.description: Whether to apply Spanish IEE (5.11%) and IVA (21%)

InviteCode.title: InviteCode
InviteCode.description: Admin-managed invite code required for new users to activate their Voltio profile.

code.description: Normalized uppercase invite code matching the document ID

label.description: Optional note for the admin (e.g. Familia, Amigos)

active.description: Whether new users can currently redeem this code

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who created this code

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when code was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest code update

UserEnergyProfile.title: UserEnergyProfile
UserEnergyProfile.description: Private synced document storing a user's persistent current tariff and consumption profile.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner

inviteCode.description: Invite code redeemed upon activation (or ADMIN for the owner)

consumption.description: User's monthly consumption and power profile

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest sync update

/inviteCodes/{codeId}.description: Admin-only collection of active/inactive invite codes verified server-side during user profile creation.

/users/{userId}.description: Private per-user synced energy tariff and consumption profile, isolated to each verified owner.
